caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent, stemmed drinking glass centered on a plain, beige background. The glass is cylindrical with a slightly flared rim and a medium-length stem leading down to a broad, circular base. The body of the glass features subtle vertical facets, giving it a gently polygonal appearance, and faint etched patterns resembling a feather or leaf can be seen inside the bowl. The glass casts a light, soft shadow towards the lower right. The drawing uses shades of brown and gray with fine lines to achieve a realistic rendering. Numerous small, evenly spaced dark dots are scattered across the background, unrelated to the glass itself.
title: Goblet
